symptom: `create microflow M.act_login` next to microflow M.ACT_Login (also page, entity, enumeration, plain or `or modify`) reports 'Created microflow', and `rename microflow M.A to X` over nanoflow M.X, `rename constant M.C_Two to c_one` over M.C_One, `move microflow M.Y to N` over nanoflow N.Y or microflow N.y all report success; mx check then fails [CE0122] "Duplicate document name" / [CE0065]
cause: #793 made the name-clash check cross-kind but kept 'own kind has the name → handler's business' with a case-insensitive match, while most create handlers (microflow, nanoflow, rule, page, snippet, layout, entity, association, enumeration, java/javascript action, workflow) look the stored element up with ==, so a case-only spelling created a second one. RENAME and MOVE had no clash check beyond the rename handler's exact same-kind compare
file: mdl/executor/validate_name_clash.go (caseSensitiveCreateKinds, nameSpaceKinds, createClash, renameOrMoveClash, refuseNameClash, CheckProjectNameClashes)
fix: One decision shared by exec dispatch and check: a create is refused when its own kind holds the name in another casing AND the kind's handler compares exactly; kinds whose handler folds (constant, queue, REST client, …) keep answering themselves so `create or modify constant M.c_one` still modifies. Rename and cross-module move check the target name against the kind's name space (its group, or the kind alone — two constants differing in case are CE0122), skipping the element itself; check walks renames/moves updating the project name sets
insight: Measure the triage's examples before fixing them: (b) 'rename microflow to Home beside page Home' and (c) 'move microflow beside page DV.MF_Y' are NOT clashes (mx check clean) — microflow and page are different name spaces. The real rename/move defects were onto a nanoflow, an entity/enumeration, or a case-only same-kind name. And the case-only fix must be gated on the handler's own comparison, or it breaks `or modify` for kinds that already fold
